the second assertion cannot fail once line 390 passes, because OTHER_PROJECT and PROJECT are distinct module constants, so it adds no coverage against any regression the pair of assertion lines exists to catch

the probe's EXIT_METRIC sums counts["dirty"] and counts["clean"], neither of which the loop increments, so held_trees=0 is a constant rather than a measurement; the fragment does not lean on it, but the log's headline metric would tell a reader the opposite of the scoped rows it prints
